title: 2027-2028 H2O'Lyon Water Science/Collegium Fellowship
institution: Collegium de Lyon (Institut d'études avancées de Lyon) and H2O'Lyon
level: Professors or equivalent researchers based outside France
about: The Collegium de Lyon and H2O'Lyon host a researcher in residence in Lyon, France for five to ten months in 2027-2028, for a freshwater research project linked to an H2O'Lyon partner lab. Open to professors or equivalent based outside France. Deadline: 18 December 2026.
requirements: Professorship or equivalent research position at an academic institution outside France
Research project on freshwater issues matching the interests of a local H2O'Lyon partner laboratory

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
why: "Research project on freshwater issues matching the interests of a local H2O'Lyon partner laboratory" → "Use AI to support literature exploration, academic reading, information organization, research planning, and knowledge synthesis"

"Professorship or equivalent research position at an academic institution outside France" → "Improve academic workflows involving writing support, data exploration, note organization, document analysis, and research knowledge management"
